summary: Arbitration award validity under clauses 65/65A; no further claims after final bill submission; Accord & satisfaction vs vitiated consent; Arbitrator bound by contract terms; Bharat Coking Coal precedent on ignoring contractual clauses; Master Construction distinction; Payment followed by No Claims Certificate; Delayed claims disallowed; Section 34 appeal outcome.
final_judgment: Appellant's appeal allowed; impugned High Court order overturned; arbitration award upheld per contractual clauses 65/65A.
